calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as web_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_sales_net DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sale,
    MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale,
    COUNT(*) as total_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN 1 END) as web_lines
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as web_lines_since_migration,
    SUM(net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
    AND sale_date >= '2025-11-03'

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date) as month,
    COUNT(*) as web_lines,
    SUM(net_amount) as web_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date)
ORDER BY month DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    MIN(sale_date) as first_web_sale,
    MAX(sale_date) as last_web_sale
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT 
    MIN(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as first_web_order,
    MAX(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as last_web_order,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as sales_lines_from_nov3_onward,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN 1 END) as web_sales_lines_from_nov3_onward
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as staging_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN 1 END) as web_lines_in_staging
FROM stg_sales_line_load
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as web_order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) as distinct_order_ids,
    MIN(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as min_date,
    MAX(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as max_date
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) >= '2025-11-03'

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as web_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_sales_net DESC
LIMIT 10
